matches.rationale: Pred2 targets the same forward-pass update claim as GT1: the paper writes h = W0x + ΔWx but the per-modality BA^i and nonlinear cross-modal terms cannot be a single linear ΔW. Though it cites Eq. (13) rather than Eq. (3), it identifies the same invalid update decomposition.
Pred3 points at the same cross-attention scaling term in Section 2.2.2 and identifies the softmax normaliser as contradictory, detecting the erroneous attention-scaling defect.
No finding names the inconsistent zero-vector/projection term B0_{N_t} in Eq. (13). Pred2 discusses Eq. (13)'s nonlinearity but not this specific zero-vector issue.
